name: OWASP
certifications: ISC2 Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional (CSSLP)

beginner.summary: For developers, testers and new application security staff who build or test web applications and have not yet worked with OWASP material in depth. Covers how OWASP projects are organised, a private practice lab with OWASP Juice Shop, WebGoat and ZAP, every category of the OWASP Top 10:2025 with the vulnerable pattern and the secure coding fix, the OWASP Cheat Sheet Series, first ZAP scans and alert triage, a first OWASP Dependency-Check scan, and a capstone findings-and-fixes report. All attack practice happens only against lab applications the learner runs themselves.
prerequisites: Writes and runs a small web application in at least one language such as JavaScript/Node.js, Python, Java or C#
Understands HTTP requests and responses, HTML forms, cookies and a relational database at the level of writing a SELECT with a WHERE clause
Has a laptop with Docker Desktop or Docker Engine, 8 GB of RAM free for containers and rights to install a desktop proxy tool
outcomes: Name each OWASP Top 10:2025 category, the main CWEs behind it and one realistic example in a web application
Reproduce Top 10 weaknesses in a private Juice Shop or WebGoat lab and write the code-level fix using the matching OWASP Cheat Sheet
Run ZAP spider and passive scans against a lab target and triage alerts by risk, confidence and CWE, including false positives
Scan a project's dependencies with OWASP Dependency-Check and explain which findings need an upgrade, a suppression or no action
